elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to 6 months
return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.evidence: within 30 days after such expiration or termination
(c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems
certify such deletion to the Company in writing
for a period of up to 6 months (encompasses a 90-day period)
in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiration or termination

reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are expressly present: up to 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter.
The 'at the Company's request' condition attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance; the data return, deletion and certification obligations in (b) and (c) remain mandatory and unconditioned.
The document had no exit mechanic, so a single concise new Section 4.3 is a minimal insertion; no existing paragraph was rewritten and no other commercial term was disturbed.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced; 'Company' and 'HDI' are defined party names and numbering (4.3) follows the existing scheme.
